post.description:
Register a branded food with its label nutrition and portions.

Validates the barcode check digit, "davon" rows, kJ against kcal, and kcal
against the macros. Use `dry_run=true` first; warnings do not block writing.

409.description: Barcode already registered; `slug` names the food

422.description: Invalid or self-contradicting values; nothing written

get.description:
Filter values with counts for the same filters as `GET /api/foods`.

Each dimension is counted under the other filters, so the counts show what
selecting a value would yield.
Exact lookup of a scanned or photographed EAN/UPC barcode.

patch.description:
Add a label's legal name or ingredients read from a later photo.

Only text fields; a label with different nutrition is a new source. BLS
sources cannot be edited.

Set a food's group or brand, e.g. to categorize a registered product.

Only the given fields change; `null` clears one.

post.description:
Log a meal: catalog foods and amounts. Nutrition is calculated, never sent.

A meal without items is logged with unknown nutrition. `dry_run=true`
returns the meal as it would be stored, without storing it.

patch.description:
Change time, kind, note, or items; `items` replaces all of the meal's items.

Send `"kind": null` or `"note": null` to clear them. Filling in an unknown meal is an
update with items.

get.description: A local day's meals and totals, keeping measured, estimated, and unknown apart.
Recipes, most recently cooked or created first; `q` matches name words.

schema.title: Response Read Recipes Api Recipes Get

post.description:
Create a recipe with version 1, from ingredients, a cook, or another recipe's version.

`forked_from` develops it from another recipe's version; `from_cook` saves
what went into a cook. `dry_run=true` returns it without storing.

get.description: A recipe with every version (newest first), forks, and its cooks.

patch.description: Rename a recipe or change its note.

delete.description: Delete a recipe that was never cooked or forked.

post.description:
Add a version: changed ingredients or portions, with a note on what and why.

Missing fields come from `from_cook` (ingredients, portions) and the parent
version (ingredients, portions, steps). The parent defaults to the cook's
version, else the latest.

patch.description: Change a version's note or steps; ingredients and portions are fixed.

get.description: The cooking log, newest first: by recipe slug, name words, or local days.

schema.title: Response Read Cooks Api Cooks Get

post.description:
Log a cook: a recipe version and what actually went in, split into portions.

Without `items`, the version's ingredients are used. Without a recipe, the
cook is improvised and needs `name`, `portions`, and `items`.

get.description: A cook with its ingredients, nutrition per portion, and changes to its version.

patch.description: Correct a cook; meals eaten from it follow. `items` replaces all ingredients.

delete.description: Delete a cook nothing was logged from.

Amount.title: Amount
Amount.description: An amount of a catalog source with its nutrition.

CatalogFacets.title: CatalogFacets
CatalogFacets.description:
Filter values with counts. Each list is counted under every active
filter except its own, and holds the values with at least one food plus
the selected value (with count 0 if nothing matches).

Change.title: Change
Change.description: A food whose amount in a cook differs from its version; null means absent.

CookInput.title: CookInput
CookInput.description: A cook from a recipe version, or an improvised one with a name and items.

CookUpdate.title: CookUpdate
CookUpdate.description: Only the given fields change; `items` replaces all ingredients.

FoodAmount.title: FoodAmount
FoodAmount.description: A catalog food and how much, as an amount or a portion.

FoodInput.title: FoodInput
FoodInput.description: A branded food from a label photo or product database.

FoodUpdate.title: FoodUpdate
FoodUpdate.description: Catalog fields of a food; only the given ones change, null clears.

ItemInput.title: ItemInput
ItemInput.description: One thing eaten: a catalog food (amount or portion), or portions of a cook.

MealItem.title: MealItem
MealItem.description: A catalog food, or portions of a cook (then `food` and `source_id` are null).

MealUpdate.title: MealUpdate
MealUpdate.description: Only the given fields change; `items` replaces all items.

NutritionInput.title: NutritionInput
NutritionInput.description: One nutrition column of a label, as printed (use the as-sold column).

RecipeInput.title: RecipeInput
RecipeInput.description:
A new recipe and its first version.

Ingredients and portions come from `items` and `portions`, otherwise from
`from_cook`, otherwise from the `forked_from` version.

SourceTextUpdate.title: SourceTextUpdate
SourceTextUpdate.description: Text read later from the same label, e.g. a second photo of a round cup.

VersionInput.title: VersionInput
VersionInput.description: A new version; anything not given comes from `from_cook` or the parent.

VersionUpdate.title: VersionUpdate
VersionUpdate.description: Only text changes; different ingredients or portions are a new version.
